policy_anchor: Stage 21.14.1 plus accepted Stage 18.28 event ID policy

contract_matrix.name: STATIC_CATALOG_NAMESPACE
contract_matrix.reuse: no implicit reuse of gaps or retired IDs

contract_matrix.name: EVENT_STATIC_NAMESPACE
contract_matrix.extension: same EVENT_KEY may explicitly receive another free block

contract_matrix.rule: 25-ID immutable blocks; 240 blocks; explicit same-key extension only; no block or ID reuse

contract_matrix.name: SHOP_PREVIEW_NAMESPACE
contract_matrix.lifecycle: temporary preview -> atomic promotion to a newly allocated permanent generated ID -> preview row removed

contract_matrix.rule: preview identity is replaced by a fresh permanent ID atomically; preview references must not survive
event assignments and generated permanent identities are irreversible; deleted/retired identities are not recycled
allocator state and assignment registries are persisted owners, not MAX(items.id)+1 guesses at call sites
fail closed before insert/promotion/assignment when an ID is outside its owner range or collides with another namespace
fixture, migration sentinel and orphan test IDs are evidence only and never expand production namespaces
numeric gaps remain UNASSIGNED_RESERVED until explicitly assigned by a canonical migration or allocator contract
